s1.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged woman with a history of cancer presenting with a new onset of neurological symptoms and a mass lesion in the brain
salient_findings: Mass lesion in the right temporal lobe
key_facts: 46-year-old Japanese woman
History of epilepsy
Redness and swelling of the right breast
Erythema and swelling in the lower right breast
Ultrasound revealed a low-echo mass with partially unclear margins
Biopsy showed invasive ductal carcinoma
High grade, ER+, PgR–, HER2 3+, Ki67 70%
Whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake in multiple areas
Received FEC chemotherapy and trastuzumab plus pertuzumab with docetaxel
Achieved a clinical complete response maintained for 23 months
Developed a persistent headache two years after treatment initiation
CT and MRI of the head revealed a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe

shortlist.label: Brain Metastasis from Breast Cancer
shortlist.why_kept: History of breast cancer with high-grade features and HER2 positivity, now presenting with a brain mass lesion

shortlist.label: Glioblastoma Multiforme
shortlist.why_kept: New onset of neurological symptoms and a mass lesion in the brain, a common presentation for glioblastoma

shortlist.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised state due to chemotherapy, increasing the risk of lymphoma

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic Encephalitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of cancer and new onset of neurological symptoms, a possible paraneoplastic syndrome

shortlist.label: Cerebral Metastasis from other cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Given the patient's history of cancer, other metastatic lesions are possible
